objective: Produce an outcome-blind expanded historical E-event cohort and then estimate bounded retrospective outcome feasibility without weakening or contaminating the V2.8.12 prospective confirmatory lane.

stage_R1_outcome_blind_event_expansion.existing_windows: Eight already-frozen windows anchored on the 21st joint A-share trading session of each 2023-2024 quarter; do not rerun or modify them except for deterministic cohort reuse.

new_window_rule.anchor_definition: The Nth joint A-share trading session within the quarter according to the frozen calendar authority.
new_window_rule.window_definition: Anchor date through anchor plus 6 calendar days inclusive.

discovery_and_selection.collector_semantics: Exact existing frozen 18-term registry and SSE/SZSE routes; no keyword changes.
discovery_and_selection.classifier: Existing frozen V2.8.4 page-scoped classifier and aggregation semantics.
discovery_and_selection.identity: Existing strict issuer-identity rules; no fuzzy identity inference.
discovery_and_selection.selection_order: SHA256(announcement_id) ascending, then announcement_id ascending as deterministic tie-break.
discovery_and_selection.security_diversity_within_window: After deterministic ordering, keep the first row for each canonical_security_id and stop after six selected rows.

temporal_provenance.retrospective_effective_date: First frozen joint A-share trading date strictly after disclosure date.

stage_R2_outcome_resolution.authorization_condition: R1 event cohort and its content hash are committed before any stock or benchmark price endpoint is read.
stage_R2_outcome_resolution.event_population: Exact frozen R1 cohort only; no post-outcome event additions, deletions or subtype exclusions.
stage_R2_outcome_resolution.event_date_D: Frozen retrospective effective date for each event.

price_source_policy.preferred_source_family: Existing free AlphaDojo stock and benchmark kline sources already used by AI Core EVID.
price_source_policy.same_vintage_rule: For each resolved horizon, stock D and T endpoints must come from the same exact frozen stock source revision; benchmark D and T endpoints must come from the same exact frozen benchmark source revision.
price_source_policy.fallback_if_historical_coverage_missing: Fail closed. A separate free-public-source amendment must be frozen before inspecting any fallback-source outcomes; events may not be dropped merely because the preferred source lacks coverage.

analysis_contract.within_issuer_aggregation: For each issuer, median D+10 excess return across all of its frozen cohort events with resolved outcomes.
analysis_contract.primary_statistic: Median across issuer-level D+10 excess-return medians with equal issuer weight.
secondary_statistics: Median across issuer-level D+5 excess-return medians with equal issuer weight.
Issuer-level share with positive D+10 median excess return.
Event-level share with positive D+10 excess return.

uncertainty.method: Issuer-cluster bootstrap of the primary statistic.

verdict_rule.PROMISING_RETROSPECTIVE_FEASIBILITY: Sample floor passes AND primary statistic > 0 AND issuer-cluster-bootstrap 95% lower bound > 0.
verdict_rule.UNPROMISING_RETROSPECTIVE_FEASIBILITY: Sample floor passes AND primary statistic <= 0 AND issuer-cluster-bootstrap 95% upper bound <= 0.

multiplicity.exploratory_subgroups_if_reported: Must be explicitly labeled exploratory and require a future precommitted validation sample before any confirmatory use.

implementation_validation_required_befor: Derive all 16 new windows exactly from the frozen calendar and prove each anchor is the 1st or 41st joint trading session of its quarter.
Prove no new window overlaps its quarter's existing 21st-session window.
Prove deterministic selection is input-order invariant, max six per window, max 96 new rows, and one filing per security per window.
Prove announcement_id dedup works across the existing V2.8.11 cohort and all new windows.
Prove no price, benchmark, fold3 or fold4 module/path is imported or read by the R1 runner.
Freeze the R1 runner hash and validation receipt before real candidate collection.
